name: uni-public
description: Universal Natural Intelligence — the public technical documentation of the UNI estate. Generated from the working repositories; every volatile number and every source citation is produced by a generator, not typed.

scripts.generate: node generators/build_content.cjs && node generators/ingest_docs.cjs && node generators/build_articles.cjs && node generators/build_onramp.cjs && node generators/build_lenses.cjs && node generators/build_gates.cjs && node generators/build_live_status.cjs && node generators/build_mcp.cjs && node generators/build_estate.cjs && node generators/build_drift.cjs && node generators/build_coverage_manifest.cjs && node generators/build_curation.cjs && node safety/verify_coverage.cjs --emit
scripts.gate: node safety/verify_publish_safe.cjs --prove && node safety/verify_coverage.cjs --prove && node safety/verify_provenance.cjs && node generators/verify_public_consistency.cjs --prove && node generators/verify_lenses.cjs --prove
scripts.prepublish:check: npm run gate && npm run build && node generators/verify_a11y.cjs --prove
